notes.title: I'm not dead yet!
notes.notes:
This is a short progress report so you know that the project is still alive and kicking. The current release date is not definitive yet but hopefully there's no need to change it anymore.


Status:

Artwork: 99%
Story: 80%
Dialogues: 60%
Gameplay: 70%
Maps: 70%
English translation: 30%

The estimated length of the game will be around 3-4 hours. The expected pricing will be 5 USD, using steam conversion rate for the rest of the world.

notes.title: A short, casual intro, or something like that.
notes.notes:
Hello kids, this is Masky Mascarita, the head of this project and this team.
That mainly consists of only two people.
"Inheritors" is progressing well, and we can expect the main game to be finished by the end of July. Translation and testing should take a couple weeks after that,
and then we'll launch!
I'll try to post a short progress update every now and then to keep you guys up to speed.
You can also check out these resources for additional information:

English:
